```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class ExpenseFormComponent extends Component
{
    public $expense = [];
    public $itemPrice = 0;
    public $description = '';
    public $userId = Auth::id();

    public function store()
    {
        // Logic to store expense in the database
        // Example:
        // Expense::create([
        //     'user_id' => $this->userId,
        //     'item_price' => $this->itemPrice,
        //     'description' => $this->description,
        // ]);

        $this->resetForm();
    }

    public function destroy($id)
    {
        // Logic to delete an expense from the database
        // Example:
        // Expense::find($id)->delete();

        // Optionally, you might want to show a confirmation message or redirect after deletion
    }

    private function resetForm()
    {
        $this->expense = [];
        $this->itemPrice = 0;
        $this->description = '';
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.expense-form-component');
    }
}
```
